[[Cairn the Troubling]] is a [[Jade construct]] [[boss]] who spawns in the mission [[Ring of Fire]].  Not to be confused with [[Cairn the Relentless]] who spawns during the mission [[Abaddon's Mouth]].

* [[Mursaat Garments]]
* [[Mursaat Token]]

== Notes ==
* This boss shares its spawning points in the Ring of Fire mission with [[Cairn the Smug]], [[Melek the Virtuous]], [[Coventina the Matron]], [[Odelyn the Displeased]], and [[Maida the Ill Tempered]].

== Trivia ==
* A "cairn" is a pile of stones to serve as a monument or to mark a path, and in this case, it refers to the stones that the Jade Bows are made of.
